deploy-bot: Deploy v3.4.0-lite to eu-west-1 finished. Starting quick-smoke (6 probes) https://deploys.redwood/status/1765000000 :rocket:
nina: quick-smoke shows 2/6 failing: kv-prefill 503 and one embed p95 jump to ~1.1s
sam: change window til 23:00 UTC. prefer short mitigation before rollback if its warmup
sre-jo: looking at node eu-w-1b, host-2 shows repeated prefill-worker restarts, pulling logs
sre-jo: log snippet: "prefill: upstream 503, container restarted, reason=OOMKilled"
kevin: v3.4 malloc tweak might increase transient usage. Recommend routing embed to stable-3.3 at 15% in eu-west to reduce prefill load
nina: agree, less blast radius than full rollback. applying 15% embed -> stable-3.3 now
release-coordinator: creating ticket RN-5401: investigate prefill restarts in eu-west on v3.4. PM assigned, triage by EOD tomorrow
sre-jo: re-run quick-smoke after routing change: 5/6 pass, kv-prefill 503s cleared, embed p95 back to ~360ms :white_check_mark:
sam: keep 30m watch. if OOMs reappear escalate rollback decision. add runbook note: tune prefill-worker mem for new malloc path
kevin: opened OPS-1299 to collect malloc metrics and heap snapshots during warmup
ina: dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/deploy-watch show heap/oom counts/p95. I'll stay on watch 25m
release-coordinator: marking change window soft-hold to 23:00 UTC. release notes update: "v3.4.0-lite: applied temporary 15% /embed fallback in eu-west due to prefill instability; investigation in progress."
deploy-bot: quick-smoke final: 5/6 pass. Actions: applied 15% embed fallback -> stable-3.3; RN-5401 filed; watch until 23:00 UTC :thumbsup:
sam: thanks, ping this thread immediately for rollback decision if anything worsens.
